result.summary: Analysed the interface and identified minor visual issues regarding navigation overlap and text truncation.

issues.description: The system gesture bar overlaps directly with the bottom navigation bar icons.
issues.suggestion: Increase the bottom safe area padding to separate the system gesture bar from the app icons.

issues.description: The text 'Trattoria Piccol' is abruptly cut off on the right edge of the screen.
issues.suggestion: Use text-overflow ellipsis to indicate truncated text gracefully.
